title: ID0423808-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R6 170002026]-Columbus converter E17
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Converter is in error E17 and reboot doesn't fix the issue.
Solution:
Action:
RC-FI will continue by checking CAN connector and if needed, will replace converter unit (non-warranty). Dispenser roll cross ends will be replaced if needed (sharp edges - warranty case)
